# PVDAQ fixtures

`pvdaq_50_2023-01-10_excerpt.csv` (rows 00:00-00:09 and 11:00-12:59 of the real day file, every column as
published) and `pvdaq_50_system_metadata.json` come from the public NREL PVDAQ data lake
(`s3://oedi-data-lake/pvdaq/csv/`, system 50 "NREL x-Si 6", Golden, CO), downloaded on 2026-10-16.

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Cite: NREL PVDAQ public datasets (Photovoltaic Data Acquisition),
doi:10.25984/1846021, https://data.openei.org/submissions/4568.
